note: Sixth western state off the federal gap list. 9 likely_rv rows, none already in the database by recreation.gov id. 7 added (Forest Service on the Gifford Pinchot and Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie, NPS at Lake Roosevelt), 2 excluded on the size gate. Two of the adds are closed by road damage and carry the closure in their notes.

added.name: Sulphur Creek Campground (Suiattle River)
added.caveat: CLOSED 2026: Suiattle River Road washed out by an atmospheric-river flood; only ~7 of 20 sites are 25 ft or more

added.name: Troublesome Creek Campground (North Fork Skykomish)
added.caveat: CLOSED: Index-Galena Road repairs and the long-term FR 65 closure west of Jack Pass; no reopening date

excluded.name: Big Creek (Gifford Pinchot National Forest, WA)
excluded.why: rec.gov notice: 'maximum vehicle length of 22 feet' and a 'relatively tight turning radius'; every catalog site states 20 ft

excluded.name: HELLS CROSSING CAMPGROUND
excluded.why: rec.gov notice: 'not recommended for RV campers due to its tight turns and the close proximity of trees to the roads', though some pads state 30-40 ft. The agency's access warning outranks the pad lengths (Eagle Creek/House Rock precedent)

recheck.why: Sulphur Creek (Suiattle River Road washout) and Troublesome Creek (Index-Galena Road / FR 65) are closed by road damage; re-read their FS pages each season and clear the CLOSED sentence from the note when they reopen.

method_notes: Peterson Prairie is the canopy-blind case: nothing resolves under the pine, so the call rests on the per-site 'Riverfront' flags (11 sites) checked against the OSM Coyote Creek line, 17-31 m from the flagged pads. The agency description never mentions the creek, so this is the weakest on-water call of the state.

Gold Basin's two 'Riverfront' flags are on the host site and a management site, neither of which the public can book, so they cannot earn the designation (the lone-host-site rule applied to water instead of electric).
Haag Cove's imagery is at drawdown, with the water ~150 m off across open sand; measured to the OSM full-pool line (27-38 m) per the 'measure to the high-water edge' rule.

recgov_hookups.py --apply silently reverted Sandy Cove's (OK, 13241) hand-corrected water:false, because a derived group is not protected. The correction is now stamped method 'reported', which the tool never overwrites.
